web-guide-idea-66.audience: People who want a supportive place to practise speaking.
web-guide-idea-66.offer: Give each participant a short speaking slot and useful feedback. Keep the group small enough for meaningful practice.
web-guide-idea-66.steps.1: Run timed talks with a simple feedback format.
web-guide-idea-66.steps.2: Let speakers repeat an opening or closing.
web-guide-idea-66.equipment: A camera phone, quiet space and timer.
web-guide-idea-66.returnReason: Use new prompts and gradually increase challenge while keeping the routine familiar.
web-guide-idea-66.promotion: Share the speaking length and feedback approach so beginners know what to expect.
